exposure: Implementation of national guidelines on thromboprophylaxis
outcome: Tinzaparin prescribing practice (usage of different prefilled syringe dosages)
cohort: The study included data from women who underwent caesarean delivery in a university maternity hospital between 2009 and 2014.
finding: The implementation of national guidelines on thromboprophylaxis after caesarean delivery led to a significant change in weight-based tinzaparin prescribing, and subsequently, no cases of pulmonary embolism were diagnosed after caesarean deliveries during 2011-2014.
